modelOverview: The Calatrava 5153 is a 38mm Officer's-style dress watch introduced in 2009, distinguished by its hinged, dust-cover case back and hand-guilloched dial with a railway minute track. It carries forward the Calatrava's founding principle of restrained, timeless design while adding a vintage military-inspired case construction rarely seen in a modern Patek.

5153R-001.movement: Automatic · Patek Philippe Calibre 324 S C · ~45h power reserve
5153R-001.materials: 18k rose gold case, chocolate brown alligator leather strap with rose gold fold-over (deployant) clasp
5153R-001.bezel: Fixed, polished rose gold, no bezel graduation
5153R-001.dial: Silvery opaline dial with hand-guilloched centre, applied rose gold dauphine-style hour markers and hands, railway minute track, date aperture at 3 o'clock
5153R-001.description: The 5153R-001 is the rose gold rendition of Patek Philippe's Calatrava Officer's-case watch, prized for its hinged dust-cover back protecting the automatic Calibre 324 S C movement and its hand-guilloched silvery opaline dial. Every piece we offer is sourced and independently authenticated before sale.

variants.Rose Gold: The 5153R-001 in warm 18k rose gold, paired with a silvery opaline dial, applied rose gold hour markers and dauphine hands, and a chocolate brown alligator strap on a rose gold buckle.
